{{Quote|It's hopeless! The reactor core is going to blow. We'll all die!|M'anx Try|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''M'anx Try''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scientist/Legends|researcher]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He worked in [[The Warren (Dantooine)|The Warren]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
M'anx Try was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
